# Data reorganisation and ANOVA (1.3)

## Load the data

Each row of `Results.txt` is one movement: group, participant (`SUBJ`), trial, orientation
(`ORI`), direction (`DIR`), index of difficulty (`ID`), repetition (`REP`), number of velocity
peaks (`NbVelPeaks`, i.e. the number of sub-movements) and movement time in seconds.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: true
library(tidyverse)  # data wrangling and ggplot2
library(ez)         # mixed-design ANOVA (ezANOVA, ezPlot, ezStats)
library(here)       # paths relative to the project root
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 11))
```
